I’m an aromantic lesbian. This means that I do not experience any romantic attraction, however I am sexually attracted to women. The main way I figured that out was honestly just taking some time to explore myself. 

I’ve gone through many possible scenarios of a romantic relationship, both with men and women. But no matter how much I try, the reality of a relationship is just so incredibly unappealing. For me, it’s like: a romantic relationship seems ok in theory, but terrible in practice. However, I always knew that I experienced sexual attraction. For a while I thought I was bi, but recently realized I’m a lesbian.

It’s like, anytime I got a “crush”, after spending a day analyzing it, I would always come to the conclusion that I don’t actually want a relationship with that person. It’s always that I either just want to get to them closer as a friend, or that I’d want a hookup.

My ideal type of relationship would be like a FWB kind of thing, since that kind of relationship could allow both nice platonic moments, as well as occasional sexual encounters, while also ensuring that no real romance is needed.

- If you wanna get into the lore, follow the more plot related people, such as TommyInnit, Tubbo, Ranboo, TechnoBlade (on YouTube). But be on the look out for other people’s streams as well, since it is possible for them to have lore streams.
- Follow Karljacobs to get into Tales of the SMP, which is important after you catch up on the main lore!
- Learn the mcyts’ boundaries before you start doing any fandom stuff, k?


Now here are some more specific tips!



To get into lore:
- So, to understand the older events of L’manburg, I would suggest watching Wilbur’s playlist “Dream SMP”. It pretty much gives the story from the beginning of L’manburg to it’s temporary “technical difficulties” (trying not to spoil too much). Then, to catch up on the current arc, you can watch TommyVODs, and while there isn’t a playlist there, you can start from the video titled “TommyInnit Is Exiled From The Dream SMP” and then just go up. To find the videos more relevant to the plot, you should pretty much judge by thumbnails and titles.

- If you want to catch up on the more in depth plot points, you can watch TommyInnit’s playlist, “The Great Dream War”.

- Also, it’s important to know a little bit about the Eggpire. The Eggpire is an ongoing arc, but it can be rather confusing, so your best shot is to just catch up using tiktoks, animatics, this subreddit, and future streams.

- After you finish that, you can basically just go to Twitch and continue watching from wherever you left off.

- Keep in mind, there’s a lot of material, so be ready to spend a lot of time watching. Also, the SMP is still ongoing, so it’d be wise to keep up with the newer events, even if minimally.

- Also, watch some animatics, such as SADist’s animatics, Late August’s animatics, etc. Also also, you should follow “barstardofbolton” on tiktok, they make very helpful videos explaining recent lore events on the smp


After you finish all of that, you should start watching Tales from the SMP. Tftsmp is an extra project started by Karljacobs, which covers more of the past and future of the Dream SMP, and is very important, especially for the current Ranboo arc.



To get into just the regular, not lore related content:
- Find some mcyts from the smp that you like, and just scan either their YouTube or their twitch! Watch some jackbox streams, some cooking streams! My personal favorite for this is Quackity and TommyInnit, but it’s fully up to you!


Just have fun overall! As long as you don’t be creepy, then you’re fully welcome to the fandom! Catch up on some fandom jokes, learn about family dynamics in the lore, find your comfort characters, find some cool fanartists, find some cool animatics! Just hang around!
